Market today: Midterm elections are the big cloud, creating uncertainty that could jolt stocks. This kind of volatility hits your concentrated tech/chip book extra hard, especially on margin.

Your holdings: Several leveraged and chip names like SOXL (-67.12%), MUU (-40.33%), SMCI (-27.85%), SMH (-18.3%), and SPAL (-43.18%) have blown past their stops. This is a critical concern, as margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on election news for any market-moving surprises. Also, monitor your positions with breached stops for further downside.

Bottom line: Prioritize immediate risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions.
plays: Your leveraged and chip positions (SOXL, MUU, SPAL, SMCI, SMH) have breached their stops. Seriously consider trimming these to reduce margin exposure.
No new buys today - hold and watch. Election uncertainty suggests caution over initiating new long positions.
